BOOTSTRAP_PATH: The runtime path must not be a link or junction.
BOOTSTRAP_HASH: Node.js checksum mismatch. The file was not executed or replaced.

HELP: Local AI relay preview. Commands: pair, send, reply, inbox, done, start, stop, recover, status, doctor, dashboard. Data commands require --root <absolute directory>; address commands also require --as <registered address>. pair: --codex <address> --claude <address>. send/reply: --body-file <UTF-8 file>; reply/done: --id <full message ID>. start runs in the receiving conversation, optional --batch-ms 0..120000. dashboard: optional --port <number>. Human output: --lang en|ko. Saved is not app delivery. Installation: install [--dir <directory>]; uninstall --dir <installed-directory> (from another portable copy). start: --probe-ms 0..3600000 (default 30000), --keep-pending. send-only: --as <address> [--off]. slot: --action take|wait|give|leave|history|status --name <resource> --as <address>; optional --to, --force --reason, --timeout-ms, --interval-ms.
INVALID_ROOT: Choose an explicit absolute data directory; drive roots are not allowed.
INVALID_ADDRESS: Use a lowercase address without path separators or reserved device names.
INVALID_ID: Provide the full 32-character hexadecimal message ID.
INVALID_BODY: Provide non-blank UTF-8 text of at most 1 MiB.
INVALID_TYPE: Message type must be question, answer, result, or fyi.
INVALID_ARGS: Check the command and flags; help lists supported options.
NOT_INITIALIZED: Register the address pair in this data directory first.
UNKNOWN_ADDRESS: This sender is not registered in the selected directory.
NOT_PEER: The destination must be the sender's registered peer.
ADDRESS_EXISTS: An address is already registered; its existing pair was preserved.
WRITER_BUSY: Another writer or a retained lock owns this data directory; inspect it before retrying.
UNSAFE_PATH: A path escapes the selected directory or uses an internal symbolic link.
CORRUPT_CONFIG: Configuration is invalid; no automatic replacement was made.
CORRUPT_MESSAGE: Stored message data is invalid; inspect the saved record.
ID_CONFLICT: This message ID already has different content; the saved message was preserved.
REPLY_CONFLICT: This message already has a different reply; the saved answer was preserved.
MESSAGE_DONE: This message was completed without an answer; no new answer was saved.
MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND: The message was not found in this address's inbox or archive.
IO_ERROR: A local file operation failed; inspect the directory and permissions before retrying.
RECEIVER_BUSY: A receiver or retained lock already owns this address. Stop or inspect it first.
CORRUPT_RECEIPT: Delivery state is invalid and was preserved for inspection.
REGISTRATION_MISSING: Start this receiver inside its own Codex or Claude Code conversation.
REGISTRATION_INVALID: The own-session registration does not match the configured provider.
REPLY_CHAIN_BLOCKED: Replies to replies are blocked. Archive an acknowledgement or start a new question.
UI_SUBTITLE: Messages only. No conversation dumps or idle model calls. Process status does not prove an app connection.
UI_EXPERIMENTAL: Codex desktop adapter is experimental and version-sensitive.
START_TIMEOUT: Receiver startup timed out; inspect its lock and logs.
START_FAILED: Receiver exited before confirming its startup.
UI_ERROR: Status unavailable. Inspect local records without resending uncertain messages.
UI_PRIVACY: Read-only local view. Bodies and authentication secrets are never shown. Accepted means transport acceptance, not an AI response.
NOT_INSTALLED: No valid installation marker exists; removal was refused.
INSTALL_IN_USE: The package is in use. Stop its helpers and run removal from another portable copy.
INSTALL_EXISTS: The install directory already exists; nothing was replaced.
INSTALL_MODIFIED: Installed files, marker or manifest differ. Preserve and inspect the directory.
NOT_PACKAGED: Run installation from the extracted, verified portable preview.
CORRUPT_WRITER: Writer lock ownership is malformed or changed; it was preserved for inspection.
SEND_ONLY: This address is send-only. Ask the owner or your paired receiving session; do not retry under another type or route.
SESSION_INBOX_GONE: The receiving session socket is gone. Re-register in the reopened chat.
INVALID_SLOT: Use a simple lowercase slot name.
CORRUPT_SLOT: Slot state is invalid; preserve it for inspection.
FORCE_REASON_REQUIRED: Forced take requires an explicit owner-provided reason.
SLOT_WAITER_BUSY: This address already has a different waiting process.
UI_SLOT_STALE: No recorded slot action for 15 minutes (inferred; not session activity proof).
SLOT_GIVE_NOTICE: {name} given to {recipient} by {actor}; release it if unneeded.
AMBIGUOUS_ID: The short ID is ambiguous; use the full message ID.
